claude.result:
`subtrack add "Meal kit" 59.90 --every week` now works, and all 37 tests pass.

- **Cost:** a weekly plan costs price × 52 ÷ 12 a month, so €12 a week shows as €52.00. Every monthly cost is now rounded to the nearest cent instead of cut off. `add`, `list`, `total` and `export` all use the same calculation.
- **Charges and renewals:** weekly plans charge every 7 days from `--since`, and `renewals` lists them like any other plan.
- **Total:** `total` still adds up the exact amounts and rounds once at the end. It can differ by a cent from adding up the rounded amounts shown in `list`.
- **Existing figure that changed:** a €119.99 yearly plan now shows €10.00 a month, where it showed €9.99 before. I updated that test to match.
- **Extra fix:** `renewals` was sorting by the "27 Oct" text label, so "2 Nov" sorted before "30 Oct". One test was already failing because of this. I changed it to sort by date, which matters more now that weekly plans put several charges in one window.
- **Files:** I also added weekly tests and updated the usage text, error message and README.
